subject: Stratus AI — discovery recap & technical deep-dive next steps
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Tom Keller <tkeller@stratus.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 05 Dec 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Stratus AI — discovery recap & technical deep-dive next steps

Thanks for a great call earlier, Tom — appreciate you walking us through the production constraints. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we have alignment before the tech deep-dive: 

Pain points you highlighted
- Large variance in tail latency at peak (p95 spikes during batch jobs)
- High unit cost per inference when traffic scales to multiregional bursts
- Need for predictable failover across us-west/us-east with consistent token accounting
- Security/compliance: VPC-only access to model endpoints and audit log retention for 12+ months

Goals you called out
- Reduce p95 end-to-end latency for short prompts (<256 tokens) to under ~250ms
- Cut inference cost by at least 30% by using batching + KV prefix caching for repetitive prompts
- Support two model flavors: "M1-fast" (lower cost, int8 quantized) and "M2-fidelity" (higher-quality FP16) with automated fallback

Technical notes we captured
- Current setup: single-region k8s with mixed CPU/GPU nodes; cold-starts appear when autoscaler provisions new GPU pods
- Typical request size: 80–300 tokens; peak concurrent qps observed around 180–220
- You have an internal ab testing harness that pins sessions to model variants for A/B measurement

Proposed next steps
1) Schedule 60–75 minute technical deep-dive: topology + SLO targets + security checklist. We suggest Tue 2026-12-14 10:00 PT or Wed 12/15 11:00 PT.
2) Attached: a short SLA/SLO worksheet we can fill together before the call (stratus_slo_draft.xlsx). Please confirm current p50/p95 numbers if possible.
3) Internal sync: I tagged Neha and Lauren to propose a deployment topology and RACI for the deep-dive.

If that aligns, reply with preferred time and any additional attendees (ops, platform, or security). I'll follow up with a calendar invite + agenda.

Thanks,
Marcus
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Attachment: stratus_slo_draft.xlsx (spreadsheet, 12KB)

Subject: Re: Stratus AI — discovery recap & technical deep-dive next steps

Marcus — thanks for the clear summary. Couple of clarifications and additions: 

Quick clarifications
- The 180–220 qps is accurate for our external-facing service during weekday spikes; internal batch jobs (hourly) cause the p95 tail to jump by ~2.5x.
- We currently run two model variants (labelled M1 and M2). M1 is a distilled variant we use for latency-sensitive paths; M2 is our quality model for summaries.

Security note
- We need VPC peering for the private deployment option and RPM-based audit logs for data access. We'll send an official security questionnaire if we progress.

SLO targets (internal ask)
- Short prompts (<256 tokens): target p95 < 250ms, p50 < 100ms
- Long prompts (256–1k): p95 < 1.2s
- Target availability: 99.95% monthly for API endpoints

Attaching the current observability snippet and a topology diagram (current-topology.png). Also looping in Samantha from our infra team (she's helping triage autoscaler config).

I'm fine with Tue 2026-12-14 10:00 PT for the deep-dive; Samantha will confirm after she checks the calendar.

Tom
Head of Platform Engineering
Stratus AI
tkeller@stratus.ai | +1 206-555-0744

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>

Date: Sat, 05 Dec 2026 17:30:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Stratus AI — discovery recap & technical deep-dive next steps

Neha / Lauren — forwarding Tom's reply and attachments. Action items I want us to prepare before the 12/14 deep-dive: 

Neha (infra/runtime)
- Draft two deployment topologies: (A) Dedicated pool w/ region-aware routing + warm-standby in secondary region, (B) Private (VPC) control plane with on-prem gateway. Include autoscaler config suggestions and expected cold-start window.
- Provide estimated GPU count and cost run-rate for current baseline vs. proposed (with batching + int8 quantization).

Lauren (security/product)
- Prepare a short checklist for audit log retention options and KMS/HSM integration details we can send to Tom ahead of the security questionnaire.
- Confirm whether 12-month log retention is covered by Redwood Private or needs an add-on.

Technical assumptions for the proposal
- We'll recommend prefix/KV caching for repetitive prompts to reduce token work. Expect ~20–35% request-level cost reduction for high-reuse flows.
- Suggest a fallback policy: M1-fast primary, automatic fallback to M2-fidelity on hallucination detection or quality regression.
- Batching window: start with 20ms dynamic batching with a max batch size tuned to maintain target p95 under 250ms for short prompts.

Deliverables by Tue EOD (12/07):
- Topology sketches (PNG) + rough capacity model
- Preliminary cost delta (baseline vs recommended)
- Short agenda for 12/14 deep-dive (runtime, SLOs, security, rollout plan)

I'll draft the calendar invite once Samantha confirms availability.

—Marcus
